{{Quote|Is my starfighter prepared?"<br />"It's waiting in launching bay three.|Darth Vader and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone trooper commander]] [[Appo/Legends|Appo]]|<ref name="DL">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>}}
'''Darth Vader's black Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor'''&mdash;also known as '''Darth Vader's Sith starfighter'''&mdash;was one of several black [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptors]] owned by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
[[File:SWVaderLostCommand2.jpg|thumb|left|Vader piloting the interceptor in 19 BBY.]]

Prior to the issuance of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], most Jedi serving on the High Council and those serving as Generals flew personalized versions of the Eta-2 starfighter, including Anakin Skywalker. Following the relative eradication of the Jedi, most of the vehicles were confiscated and repainted for Imperial use. Darth Vader was known to keep several of these [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] on reserve, all of which were painted mostly black over the former bright colors used by the Jedi in order to better camouflage it against the backdrop of space. The color also reflected the rage and grief felt by Darth Vader during his youth as a Sith.<ref name="30th">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|pack=Darth Vader's Sith Starfighter|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/tacsithstarfighter.asp}}</ref>

Following the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Darth Vader would [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] one of these [[Interceptor/Legends|interceptors]] during many of his early missions for [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] as the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] continued&mdash;sometimes flanked by [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighters]].

Despite the fact that Vader had previously flown Eta-2 starfighters before his becoming a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], his opinion of the craft greatly diminished due to the cumbersome nature of his [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|armor]], cybernetic implants, and increased robotic height, which made it incredibly difficult for him to comfortably fit into the cramped cockpit.

Vader would utilize one of the fighters during operations in the [[Atoan system]]. By then, several fundamental modifications had been made to the Eta-2s in Vader's possession, including a vertical placement of the thrusters and changes to the wingspan and cockpit tinting. The fighter he used at that time was badly damaged during a [[Battle of the Atoan system|battle]] in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] against [[Atoan]] ships.<ref name="LC2">[[Darth Vader and the Lost Command 2|''Darth Vader and the Lost Command'' 2]]</ref>

While seeing to operations on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Darth Vader eventually turned one of his Eta-2 interceptors over to an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agent. He personally assigned the pilot to assist in the [[Rebel Invasion of Kashyyyk|attack]] on a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] invasion force in [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk space]].<ref name="SWG:DyD">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=faction|Imperial|Doing your duty, phase IV|Kashyyyk}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In [[2006]], [[Hasbro]] released a vehicle scaled for 3-1/4" action figures called ''Darth Vader's Sith Starfighter'' of their ''30th Anniversary Collection''. The toy is based on the appearance of the ship described in the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] novel ''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''.
